liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): The Dark Star is very good and contains a nice short MLB jam; Phil's bass bombs during Dark Star are singled out for listening [12][16][19]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China Cat into Rider is picked as the first-set highlight [15]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes Of The World is a favorite of the reviewer, a deep groove [12]
- **Weather Report Suite** (1 review): The Weather Report Suite following the Eyes is cited as helping make this a major contender [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **MLB Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **gd73-10-30.sbd.powell.16818.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 197 min; rated 4.57/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry's microphone makes his voice sound like an electrified megaphone, giving an old-timey feel to the recording [11]
- **gd1973-10-30.sbd.miller.32367.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 197 min; rated 4.25/5 by 16 [2]
- **gd1973-10-30.170339.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 197 min [3]
- **gd1973-10-30.sbd.19809.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 195 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Some tuning and between-song crowd noise appear to have been edited out slightly; The track cuts into the beginning, losing a split second; A volume change occurs at 3:39 in China Cat [6]

## Around the show

- The band played no Halloween show that year, so this one stands in as the nearest trick-or-treat date [8]
- Another audience tape by Karl Ryan reportedly exists, containing both Jack Straw and Dark Star [3]
- Second-set sequence of Dark Star into Stella Blue into Eyes is described as an unusual pairing [8]
- This Dark Star is called more fluid than the wild one played on 10/25/73 [10]
- Reviewer ranks this among the top five shows of 1973 and sees it as setting a precedent for November [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-10-30.sbd.powell.16818.sbeok.shnf**: source: MSR > D > PCM > D > CD patched with AUD [1]. Also: Source 12127 is judged not a master reel, but probably master reel to cassette with heavy noise reduction applied; Spectral analysis comparing 12126 and 12127 shows the noise reduction removed white noise, though it was done well; Source is a mono soundboard-style tape chain: MSR to digital to PCM to CD, patched with audience material [1][13]
- **gd1973-10-30.sbd.miller.32367.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7inch Master Reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> DCassette (Tascam 122mkIII) -> Dat (Panasonic 3700/44.1k) D [2]. Also: Patches from a third-generation audience tape cover the start of Me And My Uncle and a short stretch of Eyes Of The World; Uploader copied the DATs from Rob Eaton, with patch discs supplied by Matt Smith [2]
- **gd1973-10-30.170339.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac2496**: source: Audience recording (low gen) from the collection of Doug Lamarre [3]. Also: This audience recording was released in the Listen to the River '71, '72, '73 box set; Pauses between tracks were smoothed, and the end of El Paso was patched from a source sharing the same master [3]
- **gd1973-10-30.sbd.19809.shnf**: taped by Appears to be a re-extraction of John Merdler seed.; source: Reel master > 1 cassette gen > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Kiel Auditorium - October 30, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/october-30-1973) [22]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1973-10-30 Tue Kiel Auditorium, St. Louis, MO](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1422475630376/grateful-dead-1973-10-30-tue-kiel) [23]
- Poster by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_36.html) [24]
